description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000204
DOCKET NO. F01176224
PLAINTIFF – WELLS FARGO BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION AS TRUSTEEFOR OPTIONONE MORTGAGE LOAN TRUST 2006-1, ASSET-BACKED CERTIFICATES, SERIES 2006-1
DEFENDANTS- LILLIE MAE GOSS, HER HEIRS, DEVISEES AND PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVES AND HER OR THEIR SUCCESSORS IN RIGHT, TITTLE AND INTEREST, SATE OF NEW JERSEY, UNITES STATES OF AMERICA, DESIREE DAILEY, JAYDEN PASCHALL, INFANT, SHARENE COGMAN
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 4th DAY OF March 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of HILLSIDE, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT # 10 BLOCK # 1612
LOT # 10 BLOCK # 1612
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
123 MALDEN TERRACE HILLSIDE, NJ 07205
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $291,792.31 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter Corvelli
SHERIFF
